components.name: TiaMcpServer
components.decision: Pinned engineering contracts. V21 installs the original NuGet package; V20 prepares a source retarget and must compile against the real installed V20 assemblies. Both require a verified installation profile; AI stays read-only and reviewed writes use the interactive CLI.

V20.distribution: local source retarget of the pinned commit

components.name: tiaportal-mcp alternative
components.decision: Inspected, not bundled or selected; its read-only surface includes lifecycle/compile tools with different semantics.

components.name: HistorianSim
components.decision: core/valve.py vendored under fat_studio/vendor/historiansim with MIT license and provenance; complete batch/controller pipeline not imported.

components.name: HistorianRCA
components.decision: Documentation/reference only; no dataset or diagram redistributed.

components.name: MCP Python SDK
components.decision: Optional engineering dependency; official stdio transport and elicitation reused.

components.name: asyncua
components.decision: Existing OPC UA client/server library; exact installed version in the Python lockfile.
